verdict.rationale: Databricks documents its own background automation: SQL alerts that monitor query results, evaluate conditions and deliver notifications automatically, Auto Loader and Structured Streaming that process new files as they arrive, Lakeflow ETL pipelines for orchestration, and a Jobs REST API. Its AI side (Genie Code as an autonomous agent) is shown only as an interactive workspace assistant that asks for approval, not as a scheduled or background-triggered agent. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/trigger configuration for jobs, evidence of AI agents running unattended in the background, independent or hands-on corroboration.
